sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: NOT MEASURED — the paper uses the HA tag as a detection reagent for neuronal expression studies; no ion-channel function assay for the tagged construct is reported in the cited clip.
sites.rationale: The C-terminus of human CHRNA4 (residue 627, I) is extracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks (EXTRACELLULAR 622–627). Python confirms seq[626]='I' and the distance from the TM4 boundary (residue 621) to the C-terminus is 6 residues, satisfying the ≥3-residue constraint. The cited construct is mouse Chrna4 (a close ortholog), so evidence is indirect; position is topology-derived because the paper names only 'c-terminus' with no residue number. A tag appended after residue 627 extends the extracellular stub and is sterically unobstructed. Mouse α4 nAChR (Chrna4) C-terminal 3xHA-tagged construct expressed in neurons (PMC6802496). The paper states the tag was inserted 'in frame to the c-terminus of the mouse α4 nAChR sequence' with no specific residue named. Human CHRNA4 topology places the C-terminus (residues 622–627, WLAGMI) in the extracellular compartment after TM4 (601–621), making this the sole extracellular C-terminal junction. The mouse ortholog shares the same four-TM topology and extracellular C-terminal stub, so the position is topology-derived at residue 627.

sources.claim: A triple hemagglutinin (HA) tag was introduced to the c-terminal end of the mouse α4 nAChR cDNA as follows: A triple HA tag sequence from plasmid pKH3 (Addgene Plasmid #12555) was inserted in frame to the c-terminus of the mouse α4 nAChR sequence.

literature_notes: L1 (PMC11257679) reports YFP inserted into the TM3–TM4 intracellular loop of CHRNA4 (α4 subunit). Per the authoritative topology landmarks, residues 331–600 are intracellular; this insertion is therefore not an extracellular surface site and is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports any insertion in the large extracellular N-terminal domain (residues 27–242), the short ECL1 (298–308), or the mature N-terminus (residue 27), so no sites are proposed there. The C-terminal extracellular stub (622–627, WLAGMI) is only 6 residues long; a ~27 aa 3xHA tag appended after residue 627 would project extracellularly but the short native stub offers limited structural context — confidence is medium rather than high.

literature_other_positions.note: YFP inserted into the TM3–TM4 intracellular loop of CHRNA4 (α4 subunit); topology landmarks place this entire loop (residues 331–600) in the cytoplasm; no specific residue is named in the clip, so the midpoint (465) is used as a representative position.
